required_changes: Fix the mypy failure on src tests: tests/test_config.py:667 calls LiveApproval(...) without approved_by, which mypy rejects as a missing required argument. Either (a) add `# type: ignore[call-arg]` on that call, (b) construct the payload via a dict literal and pass to model_validate, or (c) silence the same way the developer addressed other deliberately-invalid model construction sites. The acceptance gate runs `mypy src tests` and that command must exit 0; the developer handoff only ran `mypy src/robinhood_lp`, which is why this regression was not detected.
residual_risks: Loader-level redact_text uses regex-based scrubbing. A user who submits a literal keystore_password field is rejected with 'Extra inputs are not permitted' but pydantic echoes the supplied value back via input_value='<value>', and redact_text does NOT mask that path because the 'input_value=' prefix is not in its keyword list. The error path still raises and the loader still rejects the field, so the rejection contract holds; only the operator-visible error text may include the offending value. This was not surfaced by any test in the candidate and was discovered by independent verification.
